sources.supports: getVersion, getStatuses, getPriorities, getResultFields, getCaseFields and getCaseTypes each take no argument and issue one GET to their own endpoint with no path segment, query or body, parsing the reply with the matching schema. getDynamicFilterFields and getTemplates validate the project identifier with validateId and place it as the only path segment. None of them consults another endpoint first, so no call here triggers a version or capability request of its own.

StatusSchema requires id, name, label, the three colour integers color_dark, color_medium and color_bright, and the booleans is_system, is_untested and is_final. PrioritySchema requires id, name, short_name, is_default and priority. CaseTypeSchema and TemplateSchema each require id, name and is_default and admit a nullish i18n_custom_id. DynamicFilterFieldSchema requires type_id, system_name and label and admits nullish options and sub_filters strings, its comment describing the two as mutually endpoint-dependent. TestRailVersionSchema requires a version string and its comment dates the endpoint to TestRail 10.6. Every object is passthrough, so unmodelled keys survive parsing.

get_dynamic_filter_fields/{project_id} takes a required project_id and returns an array of field definitions usable in the dynamic_filters payloads of the run and plan endpoints, matching the dynamic filter fields of the TestRail UI for that project, including active filterable custom case fields. Non-filterable types such as Text, Steps and Scenarios are not returned. Each field carries type_id, system_name and label, with options for fields with selectable values and sub_filters for condition-based fields; the examples show both as newline-separated "id, label" pairs. A field is named in dynamic_filters by its system_name prefixed with "cases:". The documented responses are 200, 400 for an invalid or unknown project, 403 for no access to the project and, on TestRail Cloud only, 429.

input_policy.notes: One identifier in the path and no body, so every field beyond it is refused. The reply describes filters for other endpoints to use; nothing here builds or checks a dynamic_filters payload.

outer_result.notes: The array is returned as the driver received it: options and sub_filters stay the strings TestRail sent, newlines included, rather than being split into lists. Entity-field drift is advisory.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.

parameters.semantics: The project whose filterable fields are read. No coercion; passed positionally and sent verbatim as the only path segment.

wire.encoding: Decimal integer path segment; numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.
